findings.message: DROP INDEX t_a leaves its comment on the table as the attribute ptah.comment.index.t_a, which YDB keeps after the index is gone and an index added later under the name reads as its own; remove it with COMMENT ON INDEX `t_a` ON `t` IS NULL
RENAME INDEX t_b TO t_b2 leaves the index's comment under the old name, as the attribute ptah.comment.index.t_b; move it with COMMENT ON INDEX `t_b2` ON `t` and COMMENT ON INDEX `t_b` ON `t` IS NULL

DROP COLUMN c leaves its comment on the table as the attribute ptah.comment.column.c, which YDB keeps after the column is gone and a column added later under the name reads as its own; remove it with COMMENT ON COLUMN `t`.`c` IS NULL
DROP COLUMN b: index t_b2 keys the column, and YDB refuses to drop it (Impossible drop column because table has an index with that column); drop the index first
